Run N55-orch300. Read Run-System/WORKER_CONTRACT.md first and follow it. Model anthropic/claude-opus-5-5/high.
Timebox: issued 2026-11-02T10:19:36+00:00; deadline 2026-11-02T11:19:36+00:00 (Dhaka 2026-11-02T17:19:36+06:00); cutoff 2026-11-02T11:14:36+00:00.
Task N55: redesign the private workspace into a modern SaaS home (Koushik approved the design, Nov 2). The current page (/workspace/*) is a narrow column of text cards: timestamp-named empty projects, five equal buttons per file, an empty Processing card, a "Connected" chip, a manual Refresh button, two stacked headers, and a stale "This project" rail menu (Scene viewport / Stage panel / Job status jump links from the old single-clip view). Replace it. Keep all existing behaviour and APIs working (projects, uploads, quotas 20/day and 1 GB, jobs, GPU status dot with idle countdown, agent first question, Agent & tools panel, sign-out, palettes and dark mode).
Design (references on Mobbin; adapt to our existing visual style, fonts and palettes, do not copy):
1. Home: prompt-first like Base44 (https://mobbin.com/screens/034bb6b7-40da-4c27-b048-5ca5cca6157e): a large "What do you want to simulate?" box with drag-and-drop or attach for a video, attachment chips, mic if voice input already exists, send. Below it two mode cards: "Turn your room into a lab" and "Measure your experiment" (icon + one line each), which start the existing agent first-question flow.
2. Model picker button inside the prompt box, styled after Gumloop (https://mobbin.com/screens/a3f8b130-cfc5-4ddc-8fd9-b95a4a6927bf): three rows with tags, Recommended = Muse Spark 1.3 standard, Cheapest = Muse Spark 1.3 contributor, Fastest = Muse Open (Baseten). Hovering or focusing a row shows a side card with relative bars for Intelligence, Speed and Cost (bars only, no numbers, because real cost and speed depend on the task), plus one line of pros and cons (contributor: Meta trains on your prompts). GPT-6.1 Sol is not listed (automatic fallback only). The choice writes the existing per-user saved model tier (the same setting the lab agent already reads, see N45); choosing contributor shows the existing data-sharing notice first.
3. Projects grid like Replit/v0 (https://mobbin.com/screens/b6981408-fb74-48cf-b31c-51f94e5dd018, https://mobbin.com/screens/1f4bf5ab-636e-43cc-9aea-1c391767d333): first card a dashed "New project"; each card has a preview image, type icon (room lab / experiment), name, status (progress ring while processing, Ready, Failed with reason) and relative time, and a "..." menu (open, rename, download, delete with confirm). Preview: use a saved lab snapshot if the project has one (the lab editor row N56 will save it; read an optional snapshot file/URL and fall back gracefully), else a video frame; for experiments draw the tracked path over the frame when track points exist. Projects get names from content (agent or mode plus clip name, for example "Classroom lab", "Apple drop"), not timestamps; existing timestamp names can be shown as is but new ones use content names, and rename works. Sample projects (classroom room lab, falling apple) appear as normal cards with a Sample tag. Empty projects with nothing in them should not dominate; show them small or hide behind "Show empty".
4. Processing appears on the project card itself, plus a small progress pop-up at the bottom right (like Shopify uploads, https://mobbin.com/screens/41729046-3f29-445f-a01f-2e86df177f60). Live updates replace the Refresh button.
5. Files on their own view in the left rail (like Supabase, https://mobbin.com/screens/5aca9059-1063-4917-90b5-218110f85887): thumbnail list, one primary action per row (Open or Use in project), the rest under "..."; preview panel; storage meter (used of 1 GB, uploads left today) at the bottom of the left rail like Snowflake (https://mobbin.com/screens/eabc3923-dafb-4de7-ad04-44f226c6473b).
6. Remove the "This project" rail menu, the "Connected" chip and the duplicate header; one clean top bar with page title, GPU status dot, Agent & tools.
Quality bar: looks like a shipped SaaS product at 1366, 1920 and 375 px in light and dark palettes; no em dashes in visible text; honesty labels kept (SAMPLE, RECORDED, MEASURED, MODEL-ESTIMATED, scale unverified) but small. Use the existing myfront and make-interfaces-feel-better skills if available.
Checks: node --test 'tests/workspace/*.test.mjs' 'tests/shell-workspace/*.test.mjs' 'tests/web-private/*.test.mjs' 'tests/web-workspace-api/*.test.mjs' 'tests/api-storage/*.test.mjs'; any touched Python api tests with production pins; npm run build.
